answer: Make each agent hold a haven bond that unlocks only after a gale-hardened proof of distinct hardware: the agent signs a device challenge, publishes the result, and two peers must independently reproduce it before any dawn payout. Cloned keys cannot reproduce each other's device challenge, so duplicate registrations stall at review while honest agents clear the gate quickly. Locked collateral plus slow third-party verification therefore makes mass identity creation cost more time and capital than simply operating one accountable agent.
